name: SiteHeader
label: Site header
description: A site's sticky top bar of section pills and mega menus, folding to a drawer when the pills no longer fit.

props.name: brand
props.description:
The brand at the bar's start, usually a logo linking home. Rendered as
given, so it carries its own link.

props.name: sections
props.description: The site's top-level sections, in order.

props.name: currentHref
props.description: The path of the page being viewed, used to mark the current section, row and drawer item.

props.name: actions
props.description: Controls at the bar's end that stay at every width, such as a search button; `condensedActions`, when given, stand in for them on the condensed step.

props.name: condensedActions
props.description:
The same controls drawn narrower, such as an icon-only CommandPaletteTrigger and a
`cycle` ThemeToggle. When the full row stops fitting, these take the place of
`actions` (the header adds `ds-site-header--condensed`), and the pills fold to the
menu button only when the condensed row does not fit either. Without it the
header folds as soon as the full row stops fitting.

props.name: wideActions
props.description:
Controls at the bar's end that show only while the pills fit, such as a
Get started button. Once the bar folds to its menu button they leave it; put
their drawer twin in `drawerFooter`.

props.name: drawerFooter
props.description: Content for the drawer's footer, such as the controls `wideActions` holds in the bar.

props.name: drawerOpen
props.description: Whether the folded bar's drawer is open, for a host that owns that state. Pair with `onDrawerOpenChange`.

props.name: defaultDrawerOpen
props.description: Whether the drawer starts open, when the header owns its state.

props.name: onDrawerOpenChange
props.description: Called when the drawer opens or closes, controlled or not.

props.name: initialFold
props.description:
Where the bar folds before it has measured itself: on the first frame,
which a server-rendered page shows before its script runs. Below this
breakpoint (`tablet` or the wider `mid`) the bar starts folded by CSS
alone, so a phone never sees the pills overflow; the measurement takes
over once the script runs. Pick the step nearest where the pills stop
fitting, or `never` for a bar that fits at every width.

props.name: sticky
props.description:
Whether the header sticks to the top of the viewport over a progressive
blur. Off, it scrolls away with the page and draws no blur.

props.name: tintAfter
props.description:
How far, in pixels, the page scrolls before the page-surface tint fades
in over the sticky header's blur.

props.name: linkComponent
props.description:
The component every link renders through, so a router's link (Next.js
`Link`) navigates without a reload. Falls back to the nearest
`LinkProvider`, then `<a>`.

props.name: navLabel
props.description: The accessible name of the section links' `<nav>` landmark.

props.name: drawerOpenLabel
props.description: The accessible name of the menu button that opens the drawer.

props.name: drawerTitle
props.description:
The drawer's title, naming the dialog. Shown at its top when there is no
`brand`; with one, the brand takes its place and the title is read only
by assistive tech.

props.name: drawerCloseLabel
props.description: The accessible name of the drawer's close button.
